Autism Parent Pathway Programme

4 sessions · 10 to 12 weeks

  1. 1
    Week 0

    Check-up

    Look at the moment together and choose one step.

  2. 2
    Week 2 to 4

    Adjust

    See what happened and change one thing.

  3. 3
    Week 6 to 8

    Build on it

    Use what works in more moments.

  4. 4
    Week 10 to 12

    Your plan to keep

    For when things come back.

Every session ends with a one-page plan, with a weekly WhatsApp check-in in between.

Questions

What’s included in the Pathway Programme?
  • 4 one-to-one sessions of 60 minutes
  • A one-page plan after every session
  • A weekly WhatsApp check-in
  • A check on day 3, and a final plan to keep
How much does it cost?

CJ confirms fit first, then shares fees privately. Nothing is paid on the call.

Is this therapy?

No. APC is parent education. It works with your child’s therapists, not instead of them.

What do I prepare for the call?

Nothing. Think of one moment that keeps repeating.

Not ready to talk yet?

Start with the free Quick Check: 2 pages, about 5 minutes.
